findings.claim: New registered hooks are added directly under compiled dist output without corresponding source files, so the required dist/source rebuild parity is not satisfied.
findings.evidence: Acceptance criterion 4.1 requires registering the hooks and rebuilding dist with `check:dist`; `.claude/hooks/dist/agent-ledger.mjs` and `.claude/hooks/dist/karpathy-flush.mjs` are added and registered in `.claude/settings.json`, but the diff adds no matching `.claude/hooks/src/agent-ledger.mts`, `.claude/hooks/src/karpathy-flush.mts`, `src/lib/ledger.mts`, or `src/lib/flush.mts`; `.claude/hooks/dist/lib/protected-paths.mjs` also states dist is compiled output and source should be edited then rebuilt.
findings.suggested_fix: Add the corresponding source files and generated dist from a rebuild, or remove the dist-only hook files and their registrations from `.claude/settings.json`.
